scenarios.scope: Client-local root pool and loopback dialer; named URL and SNI retained; untrusted and wrong-host requests rejected.
Standard-library HTTP server; external manifest linked per directory; name collision/private ports/content isolation/peer survival/cleanup/source restoration.

limitations: Local fixtures, not packaged OSS consumer trials.
No proof of OS named-host DNS or globally installed trust.
Trusted Chromium without the test SPKI exception remains unverified; existing user trust stores were not changed.
Docker unavailable; no container trust test.
Native Windows/macOS and privileged port 443 not tested.
